Analista de Sistemas | Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Rede Dór Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brasil.

Descrição

Fundado em 2010 no Rio de Janeiro, o Instituto D’Or de Pesquisa e Ensino (IDOR) é uma organização sem fins lucrativos que tem como objetivo contribuir para a evolução da ciência, de forma a melhorar a condição de vida humana. Para isso, combina pesquisa de ponta, capacitação profissional e desenvolvimento tecnológico na área da saúde. A sua principal mantenedora é a Rede D’Or São Luiz (RDSL), maior rede hospitalar privada do Brasil. Desde a sua criação, o IDOR valoriza a ciência e se mantém atento às necessidades do país na área da saúde, mobilizando seus recursos e estimulando seus pesquisadores na busca de soluções para problemas atuais e futuros. Desta forma, o Instituto trouxe importantes contribuições para a saúde pública nacional e internacional, como no entendimento do papel do vírus Zika nas malformações do sistema nervoso e nas pesquisas voltadas para o enfrentamento da pandemia de covid-19. A excelência da pesquisa desenvolvida no IDOR viabiliza inúmeras parcerias internacionais e centenas de publicações em revistas científicas de grande prestígio. Além disso, o Instituto também contribui significativamente para a formação de profissionais da área da saúde nas diferentes esferas do ensino, incluindo graduação, pós-graduação stricto sensu, residência médica e multiprofissional, aperfeiçoamento e cursos de capacitação, atividades que deram origem à Faculdade IDOR de Ciências Médicas, fundada em 2017.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Ciência da Informação e áreas correlatas;
  • Desejável conhecimento em domínio de integrações (APIs REST, mensageria), bancos de dados (Oracle/SQL Server/MySQL), queries/otimização e leitura de logs, Sistemas Operacionais Linux e Windows, Infraestrutura do Mercado, segurança da informação e redes.

Atividades

  • Assegurar a continuidade operacional e a interoperabilidade entre sistemas (novos e legados), priorizando alta disponibilidade, segurança e conformidade regulatória;
  • Organizar escopo, cronograma, recursos e comunicação; garantir qualidade, prazos em projetos/demandas críticas, controle de backlog e na toda rotina de sustentação;
  • Conduzir detecção, diagnóstico, mitigação e pós-incidente (RCA), manter planos de contingência e reduzir riscos operacionais;
  • Propor e implementar otimizações e automações para eficiência, redução de retrabalho e resposta rápida - ambientes de alta pressão e alta disponibilidade.

description:
ENGIE Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Join to apply for the Pessoa Engenheira de Gestão de Ativos role at ENGIE

No mundo, a ENGIE é um importante player na transição energética, com o propósito de acelerar a jornada rumo a uma economia neutra em carbono. Presente em 30 países e com 98 mil colaboradores, o Grupo atua em toda a cadeia de valor da energia, da geração renovável e gás verde à infraestrutura e fornecimento.

No Brasil, a ENGIE, empresa líder em energia 100% renovável do país, atua em geração, comercialização e transmissão de energia elétrica, Operação, manutenção e transporte de gás, e soluções energéticas. A empresa possui cerca de 13 GW de capacidade instalada, provenientes de fontes renováveis e com baixas emissões de Gases de Efeito Estufa (GEE), como usinas hidrelétricas, eólicas, solares e a biomassa.

A ENGIE Soluções de Operação e Manutenção é responsável por operar e manter os gasodutos da TAG, empresa adquirida pelo grupo em 2020. Com a aquisição da TAG, a ENGIE é detentora da mais extensa malha de transporte de gás natural do país com 4.500 km que atravessam 10 estados e 191 municípios.

Missão do Cargo

Atuar de forma estratégica e técnica na gestão do ciclo de vida dos ativos do gasoduto, garantindo sua integridade, confiabilidade e desempenho, por meio da aplicação integrada de soluções de engenharia nas disciplinas de medição, automação, elétrica, equipamentos rotativos, compressores, proteção catódica, geotecnia e engenharia de integridade.

Assegurar a disponibilidade operacional, o cumprimento das normas técnicas e regulatórias, e o alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio, promovendo uma abordagem preventiva e sustentável.

Responsabilidades Principais

  • Executar e apoiar tecnicamente as inspeções e avaliações de integridade dos equipamentos e dutos, realizando acompanhamento de campo, controle de relatórios e registros técnicos, e garantindo o cumprimento das normas aplicáveis
  • Acompanhar a execução de reparos e adequações identificadas nas inspeções, verificando a conformidade técnica das intervenções com os códigos de projeto, normas regulamentadoras e especificações internas.
  • Realizar análises técnicas de falhas e contribuir em estudos de melhoria contínua, aplicando metodologias como RCA, FMEA e RCM, e propondo soluções técnicas que reforcem a confiabilidade dos ativos
  • Elaborar e revisar procedimentos técnicos e instruções de trabalho, assegurando alinhamento com os padrões corporativos e oferecendo suporte técnico ao time de manutenção e inspeção.
  • Monitorar a condição e a funcionalidade dos dispositivos de proteção mecânica, como válvulas de alívio e sistemas contra sobrepressão, realizando inspeções técnicas e mantendo atualizada a documentação correspondente.
  • Dar suporte técnico à gestão de mudanças e à resposta a emergências, participando do desenvolvimento de MoCs e colaborando em investigações de falhas e incidentes envolvendo sistemas pressurizados.
  • Disseminar boas práticas de confiabilidade e apoiar auditorias técnicas, contribuindo para a formação técnica das equipes, participando de comitês quando solicitado e promovendo a padronização dos processos de engenharia.
  • Coletar, analisar e acompanhar indicadores de confiabilidade e integridade, colaborando com a área corporativa no desenvolvimento de KPIs e estudos estatísticos que embasem a tomada de decisão técnica.

Requisitos

  • Formação: Ensino Superior Completo;
  • Áreas de formação: Engenharia Elétrica, Eletrônica, Mecânica e áreas afins;
  • Desejável: Especialização (Pós-Graduação/MBA);
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Metodologias de Confiabilidade (RCA, FMEA, RCM), Inspeção e Integridade de Equipamentos Estáticos e Dinâmicos, Gestão de Indicadores e Análise de Dados Técnicos e Elaboração de Procedimentos Técnicos e Apoio a MoCs;
  • Certificações: CREA

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.
Buscamos um Analista N2 Pleno para cuidar da parte técnica da rede e apoiar a expansão da empresa.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável , resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3 .

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim , sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo .
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa .

Jornada / Modelo

  • Regime: CLT – 44h semanais
  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial

title: Fund Administrator
description:
Our client is a growing fund services provider with a strong focus on crypto and digital assets. With plans to expand into corporate services, regulatory support, and investor transactions, they are building a forward‑looking team to support this growth.

We are seeking a Fund Administrator to support the current Manager of Fund Administration and play a key role in day‑to‑day fund operations. This mid‑level role is designed for someone who wants to grow into management over time as the business evolves.

This role is ideal for a detail‑oriented professional with solid fund administration experience and a strong interest in digital assets. The right candidate will be proactive, adaptable, and motivated to build a career in a fast‑changing sector.

Full‑Time

Schedule: Bahamas time zone

Location: Fully remote (fluent English and Portuguese required; Brazil‑based candidates preferred)

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1600–$3200 (depending on level of experience)

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage investor onboarding and compliance, including KYC/AML checks.
  • Maintain accurate investor registry records (investors, unit/share classes, transactions).
  • Process subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, capital calls, and distributions.
  • Prepare and send investor statements, handle queries, and liaise with custodians.
  • Prepare and review investor reports, financial statements, and regulatory filings.
  • Handle transactions and reporting related to crypto assets (valuation, custody, liquidity).
  • Ensure compliance with AML/KYC, FATCA/CRS, and relevant digital asset regulations.
  • Support the Fund Administration Manager in building processes and internal controls.
  • Liaise with auditors, custodians, and regulators as required.
  • Stay up to date with digital asset fund regulations and apply them in operations.

Requirements

  • ~5 years of experience in fund administration, ideally with exposure to digital asset/crypto funds.
  • Strong knowledge of fund operations: NAV calculation, reconciliation, investor reporting, compliance.
  • Hands‑on experience with investor services (onboarding, AML/KYC, registry, subscriptions/redemptions, capital calls).
  • Familiarity with crypto‑specific operations (custody, valuation, liquidity, transaction handling).
  • Understanding of compliance and regulatory frameworks (AML/KYC, FATCA/CRS).
  • Proficiency in Excel and fund administration software (e.g., Advent, Investran, PFS‑PAXUS).
  • High attention to detail and accuracy with financial data.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English; Portuguese required for Brazil‑based applicants.

Nice‑to‑Haves

  • Relevant certifications (CAIA, CFA, CPA modules, blockchain/crypto finance certifications).
  • Experience with corporate services, regulatory reporting, or investor transactions.
  • Previous exposure to start‑up or fast‑growing fund administration environments.
  • Growth mindset — staying updated on trends/regulations in digital assets.

Recruitment Process

  • Initial Interview
  • Client Interview(s)
  • Offer & Onboarding

description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You’re able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world‑building assets. You’re likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper‑focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You’ll work on our Performance Creative service—our AI‑powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game‑changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of 50‑100 new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance—combining bold visual storytelling with data‑informed design decisions. You’ll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short‑form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high‑volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data‑backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you’ll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high‑tempo creative strategy and direction for full‑funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short‑form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client’s marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb‑stop rate, hold rate, and click‑through rate. You’re super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross‑Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile‑first videos, and storyboards for short‑form content. You’re capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn’t the role for strategy‑only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short‑form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short‑form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low‑fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy‑only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb‑stop rate, 3‑second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI‑assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You’re an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients.

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand‑holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy‑only with no hands‑on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote , employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model , including weekly in‑office appearances . Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

Vaga: 2º Oficial de Máquinas – Aliança ( Cabotagem )

Oferecemos a você ótimas oportunidades de carreira com alcance internacional para expandir ainda mais sua experiência através de nossas premiadas iniciativas de desenvolvimento de talentos com foco na diversidade. No Grupo Maersk valorizamos a diversidade de nossos talentos e buscamos recrutar as melhores pessoas - valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas, promovemos a inclusão não se limitando a: gênero, idade, nacionalidade, raça, orientação sexual, deficiência ou crenças religiosas. title: Associate Director, Design
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the role

We are hiring an Associate Director, Design - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in both managing creative talent and driving high-quality design execution across various platforms. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

You will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of leadership and creativity in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment, where you’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-2 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e‑commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3‑6+ years of senior‑level design experience, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

Descrição

Quer trabalhar na maior empresa de bikes elétricas do Brasil?
Nascemos em 2010, no Rio de Janeiro.
A nossa missão desde então é fazer com que as pessoas reflitam sobre os seus hábitos.
E não apenas os hábitos relacionados à mobilidade urbana.
Queremos que as pessoas olhem mais ao seu redor.
Como você leva a sua vida?
Qual é a sua relação com a natureza, com o tempo, com o seu trabalho, família e amigos?
A nossa marca não é apenas sobre bicicletas elétricas.
A Lev é sobre escolhas, como escolher o caminho mais bonito em vez do mais rápido.
E por falar em caminho, que ele seja sempre a melhor parte.

Join to apply for the Analista de Melhoria Contínua - Rio de Janeiro/RJ (Presencial) role at OceanPact Serviços Marítimos

Sobre a OceanPact

A OceanPact é uma empresa brasileira especializada em serviços marítimos, atuando com excelência nas áreas de meio ambiente, engenharia e logística offshore. Com presença sólida no mercado e atuação em todo o território nacional, oferecemos soluções integradas e sustentáveis para os desafios do mar. Nosso propósito é transformar o cuidado com o mar em valor para todos.

Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Melhoria Contínua para atuar na área de Melhoria Contínua, responsável por identificar oportunidades de otimização de processos, aumentar eficiência operacional e apoiar a cultura de melhoria contínua dentro da organização. Espera-se que esse(a) profissional atue de forma analítica e estruturada para mapear fluxos, diagnosticar problemas, implementar soluções e acompanhar resultados, sempre com foco em produtividade, padronização e mitigação de riscos.

Responsabilidades

  • Liderar projetos voltados à melhoria contínua dos processos de diversas áreas;
  • Desenvolver fluxos de processos para realizar diagnósticos dos processos existentes, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e liderando as iniciativas propostas;
  • Utilizar metodologias como Lean, Six Sigma e BPMN para promover a melhoria contínua, revisando e aprimorando processos para aumentar a eficiência;
  • Acompanhar o impacto das melhorias implementadas e gerar relatórios de performance e reportar aos executivos;
  • Traduzir dados em ações práticas e recomendações claras para a alta liderança;
  • Liderar iniciativas de automação e otimização de processos, desde o planejamento até a implementação, garantindo que os projetos atendam às necessidades dos stakeholders e estejam alinhados aos objetivos estratégicos.

Requisitos

  • Formação em Engenharias, Administração ou áreas afins;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias Lean, Six Sigma, PDCA;
  • Experiência com mapeamento de processos (BPMN, SIPOC, 5W2H);
  • Domínio de Excel avançado e ferramentas de análise de dados;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização (Power BI, Tableau, Looker);
  • Conhecimento básico de automação (RPA, scripts, workflows);
  • Capacidade de documentar processos e criar padrões operacionais;
  • Gestão de projetos (cronograma, riscos, entregáveis).

Local de trabalho

  • Modalidade: Presencial

O que buscamos

  • Dá pra fazer, com responsabilidade e qualidade
  • O jeito certo: ética, segurança e excelência
  • Gostamos do que fazemos: entusiasmo e envolvimento
  • Confiança: relações transparentes e comprometidas
  • Inovação: melhoria contínua e novas ideias
  • Resultados: foco em entregas com valor

description:
Sobre a Área

A Engenharia Clínica é a área responsável pela gestão do parque de Equipamentos Médicos do Centro de Diagnóstico do Grupo Fleury. Durante a vida útil do equipamento, da aquisição ao descarte, uma série de ações e processos regulatórios e de melhorias são executados a fim de manter a o funcionamento, rastreabilidade do equipamento, qualidade, segurança e confiabilidade como consequência.

Detalhes da vaga

Principais Atividades

  • Realizar abertura de chamados através dos canais de comunicação dos fornecedores, garantindo atendimento aos equipamentos;
  • Executar manutenções de baixa a média complexidade em equipamentos;
  • Avaliar, auxiliar e acompanhar presencial ou remotamente, os fornecedores nas intervenções de manutenções, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos;
  • Executar manutenções de baixa a média complexidade em equipamentos, utilizando as ferramentas disponíveis;
  • Realizar e manter o inventário atualizado no sistema de gestão;
  • Realizar abertura de chamados para ações conjuntas com outras áreas de interfaces;
  • Realizar a abertura e fechamento de ordem de serviço no sistema de gestão de equipamentos para garantir informações de vida útil do equipamento e atendimento à requisitos legais;
  • Acompanhar instalações de equipamentos médicos garantindo o funcionamento adequado do equipamento;
  • Realizar instalações e desinstalações de média complexidade;
  • Realizar atividades técnicas de manutenções programadas;
  • Realizar análise crítica e pesquisa de defeito em equipamentos de alta complexidade;
  • Executar operações (manobras) de emergência conforme treinamento ou orientação nos equipamentos médicos;
  • Executar e apoiar as atividades relacionadas à manutenção e instalação de equipamentos da área de tecnologias em saúde assegurando a maior disponibilidade do parque tecnológico em todo o Grupo Fleury.

Buscamos Alguém Que Apresente

  • Formação técnica em eletrônica, eletrotécnica, mecatrônica, equipamentos biomédicos e afins;
  • Experiência em manutenção de equipamentos biomédicos, atuação em fornecedores de serviços ou equipes de engenharia clínica;
  • Conhecimento em manutenção de bancada e de instrumentos técnicos de manutenção (amperímetro, multímetro etc.);
  • Conhecimento em equipamentos de Centro Diagnóstico;
  • Capacidade de interpretação de laudos técnicos e manuais de utilização, habilidade em multiplicar o conhecimento;
  • Familiaridade com softwares de manutenção.

Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.

Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:

  • Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
  • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
  • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
  • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
  • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
  • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial - Trabalho de campo nas regiões: Zona Sul, Botafogo e Meier.

Software Platform Engineering Manager – Ubuntu for Next‑Gen Silicon

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT.

With more than 1,200 colleagues in 75 countries, Canonical is a founder‑led, profitable, and constantly growing company that champions global distributed collaboration. What your day will look like

  • Lead and develop a team of engineers, ranging from graduate to senior
  • Oversee commercial engagements and support timely delivery on agreed project milestones
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures
  • Implement disciplined engineering processes
  • Integrate and maintain platform‑oriented software stacks
  • Optimize Ubuntu for latest hardware platforms
  • Display technical leadership internally and within our external communities
  • Contribute to code reviews and technical documentation
  • Be an active part of the leadership team, collaborating with other leaders

What we’re looking for in you

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • Fluency in C, C++, and Python
  • Experience with Linux and operational systems software (e.g. kernel or user space)
  • Experience with Debian/Ubuntu or other distro packaging
  • Experience leading software engineering teams
  • Professional written and spoken English
  • Confidence to respectfully speak up, exchange feedback, and share ideas without hesitation
  • Thoughtfulness, and self‑motivation

  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

Nice‑to‑have skills

  • Experience working with open source communities and licenses
  • Computer architecture knowledge of x86, ARM, RISC‑V or s390x
  • Understanding of build systems and toolchains, including for cross‑compilation
  • Experience working with customers
  • Experience with board bring‑up and validation
  • Experience with Linux virtualization, networking or graphics stacks
  • Experience with one or more of the follow
  • Experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s
  • ing technologies: confidential computing, RDMA, Infiniband and high performance computing.
  • Performance engineering, benchmarking and profiling

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance‑driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence – in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote‑first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Where will you be working?

You will be joining Royal Den Hartogh Logistics, an international and leading logistics service provider for the chemical, gas, polymer, and food industries. Our family-owned company was founded in 1920 and has safety and sustainability firmly embedded in its DNA. Together with our customers and partners, we continuously develop smart logistics solutions that contribute to an efficient and future-proof supply chain. With 54 locations in 27 countries, a team of more than 2,600 colleagues worldwide, and a modern fleet of 25,000 tank containers, 5,000 dry bulk containers and trailers, 575 tank trailers, and nearly 900 trucks, we have everything needed to make an impact on a global scale.

About the Team

At Den Hartogh Logistics, you’ll join a team of committed finance professionals who go the extra mile, take ownership, and enjoy working together. The Latin America Finance Team ensures accurate and compliant day-to-day finance operations across Brazil and collaborates closely with partners throughout Latin America. We work with a global mindset, combining precision, accountability, and a passion for continuous improvement. Our office is located in Barra da Tijuca/Jacarepaguá neighborhood in Rio de Janeiro.

About the Role

As a Finance & Accounting Analyst in our Rio de Janeiro office at Barra Olímpica, you will play a key role in safeguarding our financial accuracy, supporting business growth, and ensuring the smooth execution of local finance routines. This is a great opportunity to apply your analytical mindset, deepen your financial expertise, and grow toward future leadership responsibilities within Den Hartogh. You will work on accounting activities, reporting, invoicing, collections, and administrative routines that keep our Brazilian operations running efficiently.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute accounting entries and financial routines in accordance with Brazilian GAAP and Den Hartogh standards;
  • Process invoices, monitor accounts receivable, and secure timely and accurate collections;
  • Prepare, analyse, and present financial reports and forecasts to support data-driven decision-making;
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian accounting, tax, and regulatory requirements;
  • Coordinate with internal teams to identify cost-saving opportunities and enhance financial performance;
  • Support payroll and tax-related routines, ensuring accuracy and compliance;
  • Manage office administrative tasks such as document control, licensing, and audit support.

The ideal candidate

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Administration, Economics, or related fields;
  • Experience in finance or accounting plus certifications (CRC, CFA, CPA, CMA);
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian accounting procedures, taxation, and compliance;
  • Advanced analytical abilities and confidence working with financial data;
  • Proficiency with accounting systems, financial tools, and MS Office (especially Excel);
  • Excellent communication skills for interaction with Brazilian and international customers;
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English; Spanish is an advantage.

What we Offer

Working at Den Hartogh means joining a global family where your growth matters. We offer:

  • A competitive salary aligned with local market standards;
  • A comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance , meal vouchers , and home-office days ;
  • Opportunities for international exposure , training, and long-term career development;
  • A dynamic, collaborative, and supportive workplace where your impact is visible.

In this role, you will support client hiring managers with filling their vacancies to target start dates, ensuring all quality thresholds and SLA/KPIs are met. They will deliver excellent recruitment services to the client in line with agreed service levels, acting as the custodian of candidate quality and the hiring manager experience.

They will use a range of data‑led sourcing insights to determine the best hiring strategy for each requisition, leveraging data, historic hiring trends, and market analysis to find the best talent in the market.

You will be aligned to high‑touch client business units or stakeholder groups that require additional attention, this includes more challenging or senior stakeholder groups, more complex or hard‑to‑fill role types, roles that have a greater strategic significance.

Client Stakeholder Relationships

Internal Stakeholder Relationships

  • Collaborate with Talent Sourcing, Insights, Talent Attraction, and Administration teams for a smooth client and candidate experience.

Skills & Experience

You’ll need to demonstrate

Somos a Base Exchange, a futura nova Bolsa de Valores do Brasil, com sede no Rio de Janeiro. Main responsibilities

Como Supervisor de Prevenção de Perdas, você fará:

  • Visitas em loja: responsável por realizar auditorias presenciais das rotinas e processos em um grupo específico de lojas, efetuando as correções e ajustes necessários para assegurar o controle e a redução de perdas e quebras nas localidades, conforme metas pré-estabelecidas.

Apply now:

Leadership & Design Experience

  • Demonstrated ability to give feedback that accelerates growth and elevates work quality
  • Extreme Ownership - Takes full accountability for team results; never blames or makes excuses
  • Beyond Excellence - Sets impossibly high standards and inspires team to exceed them
  • Proactive Curiosity - Anticipates problems, asks better questions, and stays ahead of needs
  • Mission Focus - Obsesses about client success and team development over personal recognition

RESULTS:

Team Performance

  • Designer retention rate exceeds 85% annually with clear development and career progression
  • New designers productive at 80% capacity within 30-60 days through your training systems
  • 100% of direct reports show measurable skill improvement quarter-over-quarter

At Guerbet, we build lasting relationships so that to enable people to live better. This is Our Purpose.

We are a global leader in medical imaging, offering an extensive portfolio of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, digital and AI solutions, for diagnostic and interventional imaging. As a pioneer in the field of contrast products since the last 100 years, we continuously innovate to improve the diagnosis, prognosis and quality of life of patients.

Customer Centricity, Cooperation, Audacity, Focus, and Responsibility are the values that we share and practice on a daily basis.

Working at Guerbet is not only being part of a multicultural team with nearly 3,000 people across more than 20 countries, but it is above all about playing a unique role in the future of medical imaging.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This person will actively participate in the company's Quality System to ensure that the physical and chemical analysis procedure is carried out on production materials, enabling the product to meet the required quality standards. This is a second shift position.

YOUR ROLE

  • Analysis of in-process product, finished product and raw material
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret high performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) analyse using Empower systems
  • Control the use and useful life of HPLC columns
  • Perform sample preparation, perform and interpret analyses using absorption spectrophotometry.
  • Perform sample preparation, execute and interpret titrimetry analyses in automatic titrators.
  • Sample identification by infrared
  • Review operational procedures
  • Develop procedures for new equipment
  • Record analytical results in the LIMS system
  • Perform/record OOS investigation
  • Understand, comply with, and respect HSE (Safety, Health, and Environment) procedures, instructions, and rules as part of your daily role and responsibilities, acting to ensure your own safety and contribute to the safety of others, always adopting safe behavior.
  • Exercise your commitment to HSE by participating in safety, health, and environment training and initiatives, and continually practice risk awareness in your daily work.

YOUR BACKGROUND

  • Experience in quality control, with good technical knowledge for analysis of in-process product, finished product, imported product and HPLC methods.
  • Degree in pharmacy or chemistry
  • Experience in pharmaceutical
  • Operational knowledge of liquid chromatography
  • GMP Good Laboratory Practices
  • Knowledge of European regulations related to the analysis routine.

WHY JOIN US

We offer continued personal development. When you join Guerbet, you:

  • Are choosing a global leader with recognized expertise in diagnostic and interventional imaging
  • Are joining our 3000 collaborators who are committed every day to offering innovative solutions to improve quality of patient’s life all over the world
  • Are joining a company where we value diversity of talents coming from various horizons

Do you want to help improve patients’ lives with us? We look forward to meeting you and continuing our story together!

We # Innovate # Cooperate # Care #Achieve at Guerbet.

title: Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer
description:
Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer

Canonical is a leading provider of open‑source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT.

We are hiring a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer to our Information Systems (IS) team. This role is an opportunity for an “automation‑first” senior technologist with a passion for Linux to build a career with Canonical and drive success for users of Ubuntu and our open‑source products.

Job Summary

The IS team supports and maintains all of Canonical’s IT production services, running services used by over 60 million Ubuntu users. As a Senior SRE & Gitops engineer you will drive operations automation—using IaC, CI/CD pipelines, and Canonical’s leading products—to both private and public clouds.

You will also improve Canonical products and open‑source technologies by providing feedback, writing bugs, or contributing pull requests, and collaborate on design and implementation with other teams.

As a Senior Site Reliability / Gitops Engineer you will

  • Drive the development of automation and Gitops in your team as an embedded tech lead
  • Collaborate closely with the IS architect to align solutions with the IS architecture vision
  • Design and architect services that IS can offer to the organization as products
  • Apply IaC experience to develop infrastructure as code practice within IS, constantly increasing automation and improving IaC processes
  • Automate software operations for re‑usability and consistency across private and public clouds, considering distributed systems complexities
  • Maintain operational responsibility for all of Canonical's core services, networks, and infrastructure
  • Develop skills in troubleshooting, capacity planning, and performance investigation; set up and use observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and Elasticsearch; design and maintain monitoring and alerting
  • Assist and work with globally distributed engineering, operations, and support peers
  • Receive uninterrupted development time to focus on larger projects and automation of manual tasks
  • Share experience, know‑how, and best practices with team members in design sessions, mentorship and collaborative work
  • Take final responsibility for time‑critical escalations

What we are looking for in you

  • A modern view on hosting architecture, driven by IaC across private and public clouds
  • A product mindset, thriving to develop products rather than solutions
  • Python software development experience with large projects
  • Experience with Kubernetes or other container orchestration systems
  • Proven exposure to manage and deploy cloud infrastructure with code
  • Practical knowledge of Linux networking, routing, and firewalls
  • Affinity with various forms of Linux storage, from Ceph to databases
  • Hands‑on experience administering enterprise Linux servers
  • Extensive knowledge of cloud computing concepts and technologies
  • Bachelor's degree or greater, preferably in computer science or related engineering field
  • Excellent communication in English across email, chat, video or voice calls and in person
  • Motivated to troubleshoot from kernel to web and willing to ask others when appropriate
  • Willingness to be flexible and learn new ideas quickly
  • Passion for fast‑changing environments
  • Comfortable working within distributed teams
  • Passionate about open‑source, especially Ubuntu or Debian

What we offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2 000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team member assistance program & wellness platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the publisher of Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; to succeed, we must be the best.

Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Ensino médio completo com curso técnico em imobilização ortopédica.
  • Registro no conselho de Classe.
  • Desejável experiência anterior de 06 meses.
  • Noções básicas de Primeiros Socorros a pacientes vítimas de trauma, Higiene ocupacional, biossegurança e ergonomia, equipamentos e Materiais ortopédicos.
  • Noções de Ortopedia e Traumatologia.

Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:

  • Convênio Médico;
  • Convênio Odontológico;

description:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us! Benefits & Wellness

Basic Function

Howard University seeks a dynamic and skilled College Research Administration Manager to oversee research administration activities within assigned colleges. This hybrid reporting role is pivotal to advancing the university’s R1 research mission by ensuring compliance, enhancing research productivity, and maintaining efficient workflows. The manager will handle pre‑ and post‑award responsibilities, working collaboratively with the Office of Research, college leadership, Principal Investigators (PIs), and other stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Serve as the primary POC for all assigned departments within the college for pre‑award and post‑award support. This position has a primary reporting line to the Office of Research for strategic oversight, training, and compliance. A dotted‑line reporting relationship with the Associate Dean for Research allows for alignment with the day‑to‑day priorities of the assigned college. The incumbent will serve as a bridge between central oversight and college‑specific needs, ensuring the success of research activities across the institution. External contacts include representatives from the federal government, other colleges and universities, professional associations, consultants, vendors, and the general public.

Principal Accountabilities

Pre‑Award Management

  • Guide PIs in preparing and submitting grant proposals, including budgets, narratives, and compliance documentation.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for grant submissions to central research offices and funding agencies.
  • Review and approve proposals for adherence to university, federal, and sponsor guidelines.

Post‑Award Management

  • Oversee grant account setups, cost distributions, and personnel appointments on awarded projects.
  • Ensure compliance with federal, state, local, and university policies regarding allowable costs, effort reporting, and project amendments.
  • Monitor project budgets and expenditures, providing timely financial reports and projections.

Compliance and Reporting

  • Facilitate the preparation and submission of internal and external reports, including progress, compliance, and financial reports.
  • Collaborate with university compliance offices to address regulatory requirements and audit findings.

Training and Development

  • Conduct training sessions for PIs, departmental staff, and other stakeholders on research administration policies and systems.
  • Participate in university‑wide discussions on process improvement and best practices in research administration.

Collaboration and Oversight

  • Work with the Associate Dean for Research to align daily operations with college priorities.
  • Maintain active collaboration with the Office of Research to ensure consistent training, compliance, and professional development across colleges.
  • Act as a resource for faculty and staff in navigating research administration challenges.

Core Competencies

  • Experience in effective multi‑tasking in a fast‑paced, deadline‑driven environment with a high degree of accuracy and organization, strong organizational and time management skills with exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a busy, high‑volume, and deadline‑driven work team environment that requires coordination of multiple activities and the judgment and flexibility to reprioritize to accommodate emergency request.
  • Must be able to speak confidently when communicating with investigators and internal and external research stakeholders, excellent customer service skills, and outstanding written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills. Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Program Manager III Job Description

The Program Manager (PM) will lead the development, coordination, implementation, and evaluation of programs and initiatives for the Howard University and PNC National Center for Entrepreneurship (“the Center”). The PM will specifically work with the Center’s National Associate & Regional Director (NARD) to manage programs that help alumni and those in the broader community start, scale, sell, and acquire business ventures. In this position, the PM will specifically assist the NARD in the developing of programmatic and curriculum structure, creating speaking and teaching opportunities for executive leaders, managing and establishing relationships across the University and in the community, creating program timelines, marketing program opportunities, and any other related duties to help the success of the Center. In addition, the PM will assist in measuring program outcomes, tracking quantitative and qualitative data to exhibit the impact of the Center.

SUPERVISORY ACCOUNTABILITY

The Program Manager will assist the NARD to formally plan and coordinate programs that impact entrepreneurs in the community, along with scaling programmatic reach impact across the country.

NATURE AND SCOPE

The PM will be a University leader who will continue to drive the institution-wide culture of innovation and best practices. This leader will foster a vibrant work environment and be a trusted advisor and partner to the senior leadership team and the University community.

Principal Accountabilities

Program Development & Management

  • Design, plan, and execute accelerator, incubator, or other cohort-based programs for community ventures, along with workshops, speaker series, and pitch competitions
  • Develop and maintain a programmatic calendar
  • Promote programs through email newsletters, social media, and campus communication channels
  • Evaluate program outcomes and monitor participant impact stories to inform strategic planning, fundraising, and marketing efforts
  • Connect entrepreneurs with funding opportunities, software, tools, mentorship, and other resources to help them in the development of their business ventures

Operations & Administration

  • Manage budgets, purchasing, and reporting for relevant center programs and events
  • Maintain program data, registration, and impact tracking systems
  • Manage content and communication with program participants through online learning management systems for relevant programs
  • Manage and support the development of an online community which connects program participants

Partnerships & Outreach

  • Cultivate relationships with local businesses, alumni entrepreneurs, investors, sponsors and mentors
  • Coordinate guest speakers, webinars, industry panels, and networking events for community entrepreneur
  • Collaborate with other departments to promote cross-disciplinary engagement
  • Represent the Center at national and regional conferences and events, including campus and community events

Core Competencies

  • Experience in creating and/or managing entrepreneurship programming
  • Experience with academic institutions and/or entrepreneurship preferred
  • Skilled in data collection and analysis to measure programming outcomes
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential matters with discretion.
  • Ability to communicate effectively orally and in writing
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective and harmonious work relations with faculty, staff, community members, students and sponsors
  • Ability to multi-task efficiently

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

Bachelor’s degree preferred and relevant experience in entrepreneurial program development/management required. 3+ years of experience in higher education, entrepreneurship, nonprofit leadership, or economic development

description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Buscamos profissionais que estejam engajados a fazer parte de um time que alcança resultados de qualidade. Esses são os comportamentos que estão alinhados com os nossos valores :

Gente - Incentivamos um ambiente de trabalho aberto, diverso e inclusivo, onde podemos ser quem somos e nos relacionamos com respeito e empatia.

Ética - Fazemos o que é certo, independente da situação, e damos o exemplo. Temos orgulho da nossa reputação e zelamos pela nossa imagem.

Resultados - Atuamos com eficiência, agilidade e simplicidade com foco em resultados, para gerar valor para a companhia no longo prazo.

Longo Prazo - Assumimos a responsabilidade de tomar decisões que fortaleçam e evoluam o negócio no longo prazo de forma sustentável. Fazemos isso com senso de dono, equilibrando os resultados esperados com a perenidade da companhia.

Consumidor - Temos o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões e trabalhamos para aprimorar sua experiência, seja no ambiente físico ou no digital.

Inovação - Somos inconformados e acreditamos que é possível fazer diferente. Mantemos a mente aberta, aprendemos e nos desafiamos a ser melhores todos os dias.

Time - Reconhecemos e valorizamos o desempenho individual e coletivo para o sucesso da companhia.

Se identificou? Deixe seu currículo no nosso banco.

O Que Temos Para Você

  • Vale Refeição/Alimentação;

  • Seguro de vida;
  • Day off de aniversário;

A mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Existimos para conectar as pessoas com o que importa, servindo e encantando todos os dias e criando momentos que transformam.

Em um mundo em constante evolução, emergimos como uma poderosa força de transformação. Criamos experiências físicas e digitais que transcendem as expectativas dos consumidores e geram impacto positivo na sociedade, com visão de longo prazo e resultados sustentáveis para lojistas e parceiros.

DIVERSIDADE, EQUIDADE E INCLUSÃO

AALLOS está comprometida com a criação e fomento de um ambiente de trabalho diverso, que acolha pessoas de raças, etnias, gêneros, origens, vivências e perfis variados, priorizando a inclusão social, a redução das desigualdades e práticas empregatícias justas, que promovam a igualdade de oportunidades.

Esperamos que todos os colaboradores, de qualquer cargo ou hierarquia, sintam-se acolhidos e se orientem pelo respeito mútuo.

Join to apply for the Operations Engineer role at Yinson

Date Posted: 26 Nov 2025
Legal Entity: Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda
Location: Rio de Janeiro
Employment Type: Permanent
ERP Eligibility: ((cust_erp))

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide assistance to the Operations Manager in (not limited to);
  • Providing maximum technical and maintenance support to the respective unit;
  • Continuously improve and monitor the Computer Management Maintenance System (CMMS) for respective unit;
  • Ensure the FPSO are maintained with respect to class/statutory or other regulatory requirements;
  • Facilitating training and maintenance related activities in the office;
  • Visit the installations regularly to carry out physical verification of equipment maintenance;
  • Verify if the planning process (90Days, Annual and 5 year) is active and provide guidance if required;
  • Provide input for improvement of Maintenance Management system;
  • Actively monitor the reporting through CMMS, and other maintenance / inspection reports with the aim to ensure continuous improvement regarding the effectiveness of maintenance. Review the critical equipment spares below minimum and instruct / support the units as required to maintain critical spares;
  • Major breakdown / overhaul support. This includes resources / vendor mobilization, spares / tools follow up with supply chain and / or vendor, and any other logistic related to this break down;
  • Schedule and mobilize service team as per service agreements;
  • Review reports from technical and maintenance service providers and initiate appropriate actions as required to rectify the issues, if there is any;
  • Follow up Class, Flag and other statutory inspections / surveys including corrective / preventive actions as required;
  • Provide budget requirements to Operations Manager in terms of maintenance, long term plan and surveys;
  • Monitor and provide support for implementation and completion of Management of Changes.

HSEQ Duties

  • Every employee shall Take care of themselves and others who may be affected by their acts or oversights;
  • Not interfere with or misuse anything supplied for their health, safety and welfare; Report quality related problems and hazards or deﬁcits within their area to the HSEQ department;
  • Promote and take part in the HSEQ continuous improvement process.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Engineering degree from is mandatory;
  • CREA-RJ accredited.
  • A Post-Graduation degree would be desirable.

Desirable Skills & Experiences

  • Experience as an Operations Engineer in the Brazilian O&G sector.
  • Excellent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills.
  • Experienced working in FPSO projects and/or Operations.

If you want to team up with us as we dream and stride towards a better tomorrow – we would love to hear from you!

A Bonin Engenharia e Consultoria Socioambiental Ltda. atua há 25 anos no Brasil, oferecendo serviços nas áreas de engenharia, consultoria socioambiental, regularização fundiária e afins. Somos uma empresa certificada pelo Great Place to Work (GPTW), reconhecimento que reflete nosso compromisso em oferecer um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo, ético e voltado ao desenvolvimento das pessoas.

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional, para analisar, revisar e acompanhar planos de manutenção preventiva e corretiva (PMOC) de sistemas mecânicos: climatização, refrigeração, ventilação e exaustão.

Cidade: Rio de Janeiro - Rio de Janeiro

Principais Atividades

  • Avaliar desempenho e conformidade de chillers, fancoils, VRFs, bombas, condensadores, motores e equipamentos correlatos.

  • Verificar qualidade e procedência de peças mecânicas (válvulas, registros, motores, componentes de refrigeração etc.).
  • Analisar solicitações de reparo, recondicionamento ou adaptação de componentes mecânicos.
  • Avaliar demandas de modernização ou melhorias em sistemas de climatização, refrigeração e ventilação.
  • Verificar execução de reparos mecânicos e confirmar restabelecimento do pleno funcionamento dos equipamentos.

Esta pessoa será responsável por realizar o processamento das amostras colhidas, garantindo a integridade e a excelência técnica.

Esta pessoa será responsável por realizar o processamento das amostras colhidas, garantindo a integridade e a excelência técnica.

Realizar a execução dos exames, bem como a manutenção diária, semanal e mensal dos equipamentos de apoio e produção e a liberação técnica de resultados, orientando aos técnicos nos procedimentos de controle de qualidade. Apoiar no controle de materiais e insumos da área.

  • Apoiar o superior imediato em assuntos inerentes à sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindo soluções para problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de ações a serem adotadas e auxiliar na busca pela melhoria contínua dos processos da área.
  • Executar o trabalho observando aspectos relativos à Segurança no Trabalho e padrões de comportamento seguro, cumprindo legislação vigente e normas internas do Grupo Pardini.
  • Contribuir com a proteção do meio ambiente e colaborar para uma organização ambientalmente sustentável, através da compreensão de seus aspectos e impactos ambientais e do atendimento dos requisitos legais e outros requisitos relacionados a gestão ambiental.

Obrigatório

  • Superior completo em Biologia, Biomedicina ou Farmácia com registro no órgão regulador e anuidade em dia.
  • Experiência em rotinas laboratoriais tais como Bioquímica ou Infecciosas.

  • Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
  • Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
  • Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
  • Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
  • Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.

  • Modelo de Trabalho: Presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: próximo à estação de metrô Canta Galo em Copacabana;
  • Carga horária: 220h;

  • Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;
  • Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.

Desenvolvimento e Educação

Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.

Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.
